what: Letters of the name at screen center resolve from 30px blur and transparent to 2px blur in 1.2s power2.out, alternating right and left starting from the center letter with .12s delays, once all have settled they stay for .45s, then the whole panel blurs to 20px and vanishes in 1.4s power2.inOut — an official-site first loader where a personal name rises out of fog

options.dur: Time for one character to form (s), default 1.2
options.out: Duration of the panel fading out (s), default 1.4
options.sharp: Blur left on settled letters (px), default 2
options.center: Index of the letter to center on (from 0) — if absent, the letter marked data-center, and if that is absent too, the exact middle
options.wait: Starts when an event with this name fires on document — if none, starts as soon as it attaches
options.[data-fx-part=char]: One character — spaces are not typed as characters but left as empty-cell elements

use: WomanFlagThisReum
note: When fully cleared, adds fx-done to the panel to hide it and fires fx:done — turning on the header row and starting the first scene is left to whoever consumes it then. The original runs only on the first visit of a session and, if not finished within 4.5s, just clears

from.where: shared.js .ik-op (first-visit-per-session loader — original op: starts at the letter ‹S› and alternates outward, letter opacity 0 · blur 30px → 1 · blur 2px 1.2s power2.out .12s stagger, after .45s the panel goes opacity 0 · blur 20px 1.4s power2.inOut)
